caption: Forward-validation of early Advocacy predictions: adjudicated verdicts by falsifiability tier (unchanged).
notes: All 74 papers, 78 claims (Tier 1 7; Tier 2 36; Tier 3 35) from Advocacy records published 2021-2023 with a confirmed predictive claim (92 flagged; 18 false positives removed by blind human review). Claims were adjudicated by a single rater against evidence published 2024 to April 2026 (the evidence window predates the 2021-2025 analytic decision and is unchanged). 'Not borne out' required positive contrary evidence; corpus silence was classified as too early or unfalsifiable. Exploratory, Advocacy-only and retrieval-dependent; the flow diagram is {{F:forward_validation_sankey}}.
